The stream shows incomplete/range reads in an earlier round (backend-remind-1.log:974-1065), provider rereads in bounded ranges after truncation (12032, 12041-12734), and the purported final round’s manifest sequence restarting with config/lint.config.ts, config/tsconfig.json, and package.json at 16569-16919 after package.json was already read at 16504, before continuing docs at 16925. The first final gate command failed at 22671; it was corrected and rerun at 22761-22784 without another full review round. The dry claim at 23655 is contradicted by these commands. Question 2: No. Testing instructions require numbered JSDoc steps and matching body comments (workspace/.agents/skills/backend/testing.md:43-45), but test_api_todo_account.ts has a one-line scenario JSDoc at line 8. They also prohibit direct Prisma reads for setup or proof (testing.md:166-176); the final tests directly query Prisma in test_api_todo_account.ts:75-91, test_api_todo_trash.ts:68, and helpers/TodoSetup.ts:39-46. No material fact above is unverified.

Question 1 is no. The stream shows Round 1 finding fixes at backend-remind-3.log:10273, then only build:prisma/build:main/build:test at :10314-10339 before the new Round 2 manifest at :10424; no packages/backend check:watch invocation or clean marker occurs in that round. The rounds also begin by reading config files (:2885, :3188; likewise :18288 and :18317) before the first docs/analysis requirement (:3214 and :18355), contrary to the requirement-first procedure. Any pre-existing watcher state is unverified and cannot replace the missing recorded gate. Question 2 is no. The testing instructions require one primary accessor per test and operation-specific refusal coverage (workspace/.agents/skills/backend/testing.md:34-41, 132). test_api_todo_ownership_refuses_cross_account_access bundles independent at/update/complete/trash/history/index operations in one test (workspace/packages/backend/test/features/api/todo/test_api_todo_ownership.ts:16-34). Required boundary behavior is unproved: equal start/due dates must be valid (workspace/docs/analysis/04-business-rules.md:67), yet the date tests cover only optional dates and an earlier due date (test_api_todo_rules.ts:34-46); tie-break ordering for equal keys is required at docs line 119 but the sorting test uses distinct dates and a missing-date item only (test_api_todo_rules.ts:70-93).
